top_categories.workout_context: At mile 60 of 85, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
Gran Fondo Asociación Española's mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Gran Fondo Asociación Española's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before September.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Gran Fondo Asociación Española. Train it until it feels boring.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 85 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Gran Fondo Asociación Española's mixed terrain forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 85 miles.
At Gran Fondo Asociación Española, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
The aerobic base that lets you ride mixed terrain at tempo for 85 miles without cracking. No shortcuts.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 85 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what Gran Fondo Asociación Española's mixed terrain actually does to you.
2-minute all-out efforts on mixed terrain. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.

race_overlay.heat: September in Montevideo and Canelones Department, Uruguay can bring heat. Complete 3–4 heat exposure sessions in the final 2 weeks before Gran Fondo Asociación Española. Increase sodium intake 48 hours before race day.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Gran Fondo Asociación Española’s 85 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, TT Threshold, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 85 miles of mixed terrain in Montevideo and Canelones Department, Uruguay.
